description: This file implements the ProcessInfo class and related functionalities for process management, including retrieving process details, memory usage, and process hierarchy, with platform-specific code for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents a process, providing methods to retrieve process details, memory usage, and hierarchy.

classes.name: ProcessInfo::Memory
classes.description: Encapsulates memory usage statistics for a process.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Provides static methods related to the current process, such as user and group management.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a hierarchy of processes starting from a specific process, allowing traversal and queries.

methods.name: ExecutableName
methods.description: Retrieves the executable path or name for a given process handle or PID, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ProcessName
methods.description: Retrieves the process path for a given PID on macOS.

methods.name: FindChildren
methods.description: Finds child processes of a given process ID based on a predicate.

methods.name: FindPid
methods.description: Finds process IDs matching a given name, with exact or partial match.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Iterator
methods.description: Iterates over processes, with options to filter by name or parent process.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::ProcessInfo
methods.description: Constructs a ProcessInfo object for the current process or a specific PID.

methods.name: ProcessInfo::Memory::MemoryStats
methods.description: Reads and updates memory statistics from /proc/<pid>/smaps.
